system.description: Your Energy Core can store up to 2 Charges. After a rest, choose one Tech card in your loadout; that card can use Charges from your Energy Core.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

system.gmNotes: The playtest's OCR lists this feature at the end of the Tier 2 modules; the transcription and the 1→2→3 Charge progression make it the Specialization.
